mentions.name: IELTS Pal
mentions.description: This AI-powered voice agent helps people prepare for the IELTS English speaking exam through realistic exam conversations with natural follow-up questions, scores on all four criteria (fluency, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation), and instant feedback on where to improve. Free credits are available to start.
mentions.problem: Existing IELTS preparation resources offer very limited options for practicing the speaking portion of the exam.
mentions.audience: People preparing for the IELTS English exam, specifically the speaking portion.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built an AI-powered voice agent to help people prepare for the IELTS english exam -- specifically the speaking portion.
